construction: Shared conditional mean and positive component stochastic law with population-specific covariate sampling
source_evidence_paths: Soares2019 Table1 source nuisance and age context

population_specific.source: Each single sex/site source context age and BMI beta with descriptive moment anchors; complete assumed nuisance law and sample-standardized BMI; fixed quotas; n8000.
population_specific.target: Equal sex and donor-regime mixture; age18+62Beta(2,4); donor BMI/nuisance law; n3000. Donor labels are statistical background, not claims of Malawian target ethnicity/residence.

measurement.source_target_mapping: identity units and corresponding concentration measurands under explicit assumption

constraints_transferred: All8 source coefficients affect the shared rawBMI conditional means. Target coefficients emerge after mixing/omitting nuisances; they are not inserted.
finite_moments: Beta supports are finite; all nuisance effects finite; conditional means bounded; errors bounded sqrt6 and CV.25; no clipping/rejection/deletion.
related_source: Soares2020 not independent; no Liu covariance transfer.
